definition_en: a room with a bath, a shower or a toilet

scene: 走廊尽头的门半开着。The bathroom light was still on at midnight.

senses.title: A room for washing

definition_en: a device that stores and supplies electric power, or a set of similar things used together
core_image: 手电筒里并排躺着两节圆电池
scene: 手电筒忽然不亮了。The battery in my torch had gone flat.

senses.title: A power cell

definition_en: a large fight between armed forces, or a long hard struggle
core_image: 晨雾中一面倒下的旌旗插在泥地里
scene: 号角在山谷里响起。The two armies met in battle at dawn.
sceneCN: 这里 battle 是「战役」（第 1 个义项：两支武装力量之间的大规模交战）；句意是两支军队在黎明交战。

derivatives.zh: 由 battle 与 field 复合，义为「战场」

senses.title: A fight between armies
senses.definition: a large fight between armed forces
senses.definitionCN: 两支武装力量之间的大规模交战
senses.example: The two armies met in battle at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 两支军队在黎明交战。

senses.title: A long hard struggle

senses.title: To fight or struggle

definition_en: to have a quality, to exist, or to become

scene: 他站在原地没有动。I want to be here when they arrive.

senses.title: An edible seed
senses.definition: the seed of a plant used as food
senses.definitionCN: 可食用的豆科植物种子
senses.example: She added a handful of beans to the soup.
senses.exampleCN: 她往汤里加了一把豆子。
senses.why: This is the old sense, from a Germanic word for the broad bean.
senses.whyCN: 这是古老的义项，来自日耳曼语中表示蚕豆的词。

senses.title: A seed like a bean
senses.definition: a seed of similar shape, such as coffee or cocoa
senses.definitionCN: 形状类似的种子，如咖啡豆或可可豆
senses.example: He roasted the coffee beans himself.
senses.exampleCN: 他自己烘焙咖啡豆。
senses.why: The shape and use of real beans were borrowed for other seeds.
senses.whyCN: 真豆的形状与用途被借用来指其他种子。

intro.en: Bean is an old Germanic word that spread to many kinds of seed.
intro.cn: bean 是一个古老的日耳曼词，后来扩展到多种种子。

items.en: bean meant the seed of the broad bean.
bean covered many pod seeds.
items.cn: bean 泛指多种豆荚种子。

items.en: new beans arrived from the Americas.
bean named coffee and cocoa seeds.
items.cn: bean 又指咖啡豆与可可豆。

items.en: bean is both food and a slang word for money.
items.cn: 如今 bean 既指食物，也俚指钱。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one sound; the near-meaning group gives other small seeds.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个音；近义组是其他小种子。

entries.definition: a line of light or a strong bar
a small round piece with a hole
the part a plant grows from

normalIntro.en: A bean is a seed you can eat.
normalIntro.cn: bean 是可以吃的种子。

normal.en: The plural is beans.
Coffee beans are roasted seeds.
normal.cn: coffee beans 是烘焙过的种子。

normal.en: Full of beans means full of energy.
normal.cn: full of beans 指精力充沛。

normal.en: A bean bag is a soft seat.
Beanstalk is bean plus stalk.
normal.cn: beanstalk 是 bean 加 stalk。

abstract.en: See round beans rolling from a pod.
abstract.cn: 想象圆豆从豆荚里滚出。

abstract.en: See a bowl of hot soup.
abstract.cn: 想象一碗热汤。

abstract.en: See dark coffee beans in a jar.
abstract.cn: 想象罐里的深色咖啡豆。

examples.en: She added a handful of beans to the soup.
examples.cn: 她往汤里加了一把豆子。

examples.en: He roasted the coffee beans himself.
examples.cn: 他自己烘焙咖啡豆。

examples.en: The children sat on a bean bag.
examples.cn: 孩子们坐在豆袋沙发上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 bean 想成剥开豆荚时滚出来的圆豆。

root: 古英语 bean 指蚕豆种子，属日耳曼语词汇；中古英语泛指多种豆荚种子，近代又用来指咖啡豆、可可豆等形状类似的种子。

sensesIntro.en: A food seed and any seed shaped like it are both beans.
sensesIntro.cn: 可食用的豆与任何形状类似的种子都叫 bean。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: round beans rolling out of an opened pod.
core.cn: 核心意象：剥开的豆荚里滚出圆豆。

intro.en: Bean takes -s and joins bag and stalk in compounds.
intro.cn: bean 可加 -s，也能与 bag、stalk 构成复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，这个词来自日耳曼语。

definition_en: a large heavy wild animal, or to carry, endure or give birth
core_image: 一头棕熊在河岸边直立张望
scene: 河水很急，他还是咬牙撑住了。She could not bear the cold any longer.
sceneCN: 这里 bear 是「忍受」（第 3 个义项：承受难以承受的事物）；句意是她再也受不了那样的寒冷。

derivatives.zh: 由 bear 加 -ing 构成，义为「举止；轴承」
由 bear 加 -able 构成，义为「可忍受的」
由 un- 与 bearable 构成，义为「难以忍受的」

senses.title: A large wild animal
senses.definition: a large heavy wild animal with thick fur
senses.definitionCN: 长着厚毛的大型野生哺乳动物
senses.example: A brown bear stood at the edge of the river.
senses.exampleCN: 一头棕熊站在河边。
senses.why: The animal name came from an old word meaning the brown one.
senses.whyCN: 这个动物名来自一个意为「棕色那位」的旧词。

senses.title: To carry a weight
senses.definition: to support or carry something heavy
senses.definitionCN: 支撑或承载沉重的事物
senses.example: The old bridge can bear the weight of trucks.
senses.exampleCN: 这座旧桥能承受卡车的重量。
senses.why: This sense came from a separate Old English verb meaning to carry.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项来自另一个意为「携带」的古英语动词。

senses.title: To endure
senses.definition: to accept something difficult without giving up
senses.definitionCN: 不放弃地承受艰难的事物
senses.example: She could not bear the cold any longer.
senses.exampleCN: 她再也受不了那样的寒冷。
senses.why: To carry a load grew into the idea of carrying pain.
senses.whyCN: 「承载重物」逐渐引申为「承载痛苦」。

senses.title: To give birth
senses.definition: to give birth to a child
senses.definitionCN: 生下孩子
senses.example: She bore three children.
senses.exampleCN: 她生了三个孩子。
senses.why: The carrying sense widened to carrying a child into the world.
senses.whyCN: 「承载」义扩展到把孩子带到世上。

intro.en: The animal and the verb bear have different roots that happen to look alike.
intro.cn: 动物义的 bear 与动词义的 bear 词源不同，只是恰好同形。

items.en: bera meant a bear, literally the brown one.
items.cn: bera 指熊，字面意思是「棕色那位」。

items.en: beran meant to carry or bring.
the two words shared the spelling bere.
items.cn: 这两个词共用拼写 bere。

items.en: the spelling settled as bear.
bear names the animal and many kinds of carrying.
items.cn: 如今 bear 既指熊，也指多种承载。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one sound; the near-meaning group follows the verb senses.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个音；近义组对应动词义。

normalIntro.en: A bear carries weight, endures pain, and can also mean to give birth.
normalIntro.cn: bear 既指承担重量、忍受痛苦，也可以指生育。

normal.en: The plural is bears.
The past tense is bore and the participle is borne.
normal.cn: 过去式是 bore，过去分词是 borne。

normal.en: Born is used for birth.
Bear in mind means remember.
Unbearable means too hard to endure.

abstract.en: See a brown bear standing by a river.
abstract.cn: 想象一头棕熊立在河边。

abstract.en: See a bridge holding a heavy load.
abstract.cn: 想象一座桥承受重载。

abstract.en: See a mother holding a newborn.
abstract.cn: 想象母亲抱着新生儿。

examples.en: A brown bear stood at the edge of the river.
examples.cn: 一头棕熊站在河边。

examples.en: She could not bear the cold any longer.
examples.cn: 她再也受不了那样的寒冷。

examples.en: The old bridge can bear the weight of trucks.
examples.cn: 这座旧桥能承受卡车的重量。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 bear 想成一头驮着重物的熊，重物就是它要忍受的痛。

root: 动物义来自古英语 bera「棕色那位」；动词义来自另一词 beran「携带、带来」，由「承载」引申为「承受、忍受、生育」。两者同形异源。

sensesIntro.en: A heavy animal and a verb of carrying share a spelling but not a root.
sensesIntro.cn: 沉重的动物与表示承载的动词拼写相同，词源却不同。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a brown bear standing by a river.
core.cn: 核心意象：河边直立张望的棕熊。

intro.en: Bear takes -s, -ing, -able and the prefix un-.
intro.cn: bear 可加 -s、-ing、-able 以及前缀 un-。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; both roots are Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，两个词源都来自古英语。

definition_en: the hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks
core_image: 老人花白的络腮胡垂到胸前
scene: 炉火映着他的侧脸。The old man stroked his grey beard.
sceneCN: 这里 beard 是「络腮胡」（第 1 个义项：长在男子下巴与两颊上的毛发）；句意是老人捋了捋花白的胡须。

derivatives.zh: 由 beard 加 -ed 构成，义为「有胡须的」
由 beard 加 -less 构成，义为「无须的」

senses.title: Hair on the face
senses.definition: the hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks
senses.definitionCN: 长在男子下巴与两颊上的毛发
senses.example: The old man stroked his grey beard.
senses.exampleCN: 老人捋了捋花白的胡须。
senses.why: The word came through French from Latin barba, meaning beard.
senses.whyCN: 这个词经法语来自拉丁语 barba「胡须」。

senses.title: To confront boldly
senses.definition: to face someone or something boldly
senses.definitionCN: 大胆地面对某人或某物
senses.example: He bearded the lion in its den.
senses.exampleCN: 他闯入狮穴公然挑衅。
senses.why: To beard a lion was to seize it by the beard, so the verb came to mean defy.
senses.whyCN: 「抓住狮子的胡须」后来引申为公然对抗。

intro.en: Beard goes back through French to a Latin word for the hair on the face.
intro.cn: beard 经法语可追溯到拉丁语中表示面部毛发的词。

items.en: barba meant a beard.
barbe kept the same meaning.
the word entered English as berd.
items.cn: 这个词进入英语时写作 berd。

items.en: the spelling became beard.
beard also works as a verb meaning to defy.
items.cn: 如今 beard 也作动词，意为公然对抗。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one letter; the near-meaning group gives other facial hair.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个字母；近义组是其他面部毛发词。

entries.definition: a small round piece with a hole
hair on the sides of the face

normalIntro.en: A beard is the hair on a man's chin and cheeks.
normalIntro.cn: beard 是长在男子下巴与两颊的毛发。

normal.en: The plural is beards.
Bearded means having a beard.
Beardless means without a beard.
A full beard covers the whole chin.
normal.cn: a full beard 指覆满下巴的络腮胡。

normal.en: Beard the lion means to confront boldly.
normal.cn: beard the lion 指大胆对抗。

abstract.en: See grey hair falling to a chest.
abstract.cn: 想象花白胡须垂到胸前。

abstract.en: See a hand stroking a rough chin.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手抚过粗糙的下巴。

abstract.en: See a man walking straight toward danger.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人径直走向危险。

examples.en: The old man stroked his grey beard.
examples.cn: 老人捋了捋花白的胡须。

examples.en: He decided to grow a beard.
examples.cn: 他决定留胡子。

examples.en: He bearded the lion in its den.
examples.cn: 他闯入狮穴公然挑衅。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 beard 想成垂在下巴上的一把刷子。

root: 源自拉丁语 barba「胡须」，经古法语 barbe 进入中古英语写作 berd，后定型为 beard；动词义由「抓住狮子的胡须」引申为公然对抗。

sensesIntro.en: Facial hair and a bold challenge share one word.
sensesIntro.cn: 面部毛发与大胆挑衅，共用一个词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a grey beard falling to the chest.
core.cn: 核心意象：垂到胸前的花白络腮胡。

intro.en: Beard takes -s, -ed and -less endings.
intro.cn: beard 可加 -s、-ed、-less 后缀。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is barba, a beard.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基是 barba，意为「胡须」。

definition_en: to hit repeatedly, to defeat someone, or a regular rhythm
core_image: 鼓手举起鼓槌落下的一瞬
scene: 鼓声一下一下压过人群的喧闹。The drums beat a steady rhythm.
sceneCN: 这里 beat 是「敲打」（第 1 个义项：反复地击打）；句意是鼓敲出稳定的节拍。

derivatives.zh: 由 beat 加 -en 构成，义为「被打败的」
由 beat 加 -ing 构成，义为「殴打；跳动」
由 un- 与 beaten 构成，义为「未被打败的」

senses.title: To strike repeatedly
senses.definition: to hit something again and again
senses.definitionCN: 反复地击打某物
senses.example: The drums beat a steady rhythm.
senses.exampleCN: 鼓敲出稳定的节拍。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, from Old English beatan, to strike.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，来自古英语 beatan「击打」。

senses.title: To defeat
senses.definition: to win against an opponent
senses.definitionCN: 战胜对手
senses.example: Our team beat theirs by two goals.
senses.exampleCN: 我们队以两球战胜了他们。
senses.why: Striking an enemy until he yields became the idea of defeating him.
senses.whyCN: 把对手打到屈服，逐渐引申为击败对手。

senses.title: A regular rhythm
senses.definition: a regular repeated stroke or sound
senses.definitionCN: 有规律的重复敲击或声音
senses.example: I could feel the beat of my heart.
senses.exampleCN: 我能感觉到自己的心跳。
senses.why: The repeated strokes of the verb became a noun for rhythm.
senses.whyCN: 动词反复敲击的动作，转成表示节奏的名词。

intro.en: Beat comes from an Old English verb meaning to strike.
intro.cn: beat 来自古英语中意为「击打」的动词。

items.en: beatan meant to strike or pound.
beten kept the sense of repeated blows.
items.cn: beten 保留反复敲击之义。

items.en: beat came to mean defeat in contest.
items.cn: beat 开始指在较量中击败对手。

items.en: the noun named a regular rhythm.
items.cn: 名词义指有规律的节拍。

items.en: beat covers striking, winning and rhythm.
items.cn: 如今 beat 兼指敲打、取胜与节拍。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one sound; the near-meaning group follows hitting, winning and rhythm.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个音；近义组分别对应击打、取胜与节奏。

normalIntro.en: Beat means to strike, to win, and the rhythm you hear.
normalIntro.cn: beat 既指敲打、取胜，也指听到的节拍。

normal.en: The past tense is beat and the participle is beaten.
normal.cn: 过去式是 beat，过去分词是 beaten。

normal.en: The plural is beats.
Beat the drum is a common phrase.
normal.cn: beat the drum 是常见说法。

normal.en: Beat the record means to do better.
normal.cn: beat the record 指打破纪录。

normal.en: Unbeaten means never defeated.

abstract.en: See a raised drumstick about to fall.
abstract.cn: 想象高举即将落下的鼓槌。

abstract.en: See a runner crossing the line first.
abstract.cn: 想象跑者率先冲过终点。

abstract.en: See a heart pulsing under a hand.
abstract.cn: 想象手下跳动的心脏。

examples.en: The drums beat a steady rhythm.
examples.cn: 鼓敲出稳定的节拍。

examples.en: Our team beat theirs by two goals.
examples.cn: 我们队以两球战胜了他们。

examples.en: I could feel the beat of my heart.
examples.cn: 我能感觉到自己的心跳。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 beat 想成鼓槌落下的一下又一下。

root: 来自古英语 beatan「击打、猛敲」，由反复击打引申为「击败对手」，又由重复的敲击声引申为「节拍、心跳」。

sensesIntro.en: One verb of striking grew into winning and rhythm.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个表示击打的动词，发展出取胜与节拍两义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a drumstick raised for the next stroke.
core.cn: 核心意象：高举待落的鼓槌。

intro.en: Beat takes -s, -en and -ing, and the prefix un-.
intro.cn: beat 可加 -s、-en、-ing 以及前缀 un-。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the word is Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，这个词来自古英语。

definition_en: very pleasing to look at or to experience
core_image: 夕阳把整片湖面染成金红
scene: 湖面被晚霞烧成金红色。The lake looked beautiful in the evening light.
sceneCN: 这里 beautiful 是「美丽的」（第 1 个义项：看上去令人愉悦的）；句意是暮色中湖面看上去很美。

derivatives.zh: 由 beautiful 加 -ly 构成，义为「美丽地」
beautiful 的同根名词，义为「美」

senses.title: Pleasing to the eye
senses.definition: very pleasing to look at
senses.definitionCN: 看上去非常令人愉悦的
senses.example: The lake looked beautiful in the evening light.
senses.exampleCN: 暮色中湖面看上去很美。
senses.why: The word was built from beauty plus -ful, meaning full of beauty.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由 beauty 加 -ful 构成，意为「充满美的」。

senses.title: Very good or moving
senses.definition: very pleasing to hear, feel or experience
senses.definitionCN: 听起来、感受起来非常令人愉悦的
senses.example: She sang a beautiful song at the concert.
senses.exampleCN: 她在音乐会上唱了一首优美的歌。
senses.why: The sense widened from looks to sounds, feelings and actions.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项从外表扩展到声音、感受与行为。

intro.en: Beautiful was built from beauty, which came through French from Latin.
intro.cn: beautiful 由 beauty 构成，而 beauty 经法语来自拉丁语。

items.en: bellus meant pretty or fine.
bel kept the sense of handsome.
beaute named beauty itself.
beauty took the ending -ful.
beautiful covered looks and feelings.
beautiful is a very common praise word.
items.cn: 如今 beautiful 是常见的赞美词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the same stem; the near-meaning group gives other praise words.
note.cn: 形近组共享同一词干；近义组是其他赞美词。

normalIntro.en: Beautiful means full of beauty, whether seen or heard.
normalIntro.cn: beautiful 意为充满美，无论看见还是听见。

normal.en: The comparative is more beautiful.
The superlative is most beautiful.
Beautiful adds -ly to become beautifully.
Beauty is the noun behind it.
Beautify means to make beautiful.

abstract.en: See a lake burning gold at sunset.
abstract.cn: 想象日落时烧成金色的湖面。

abstract.en: See a voice filling a quiet hall.
abstract.cn: 想象歌声充满安静的大厅。

abstract.en: See a face turning toward light.
abstract.cn: 想象一张转向光的面孔。

examples.en: The lake looked beautiful in the evening light.
examples.cn: 暮色中湖面看上去很美。

examples.en: She sang a beautiful song at the concert.
examples.cn: 她在音乐会上唱了一首优美的歌。

examples.en: We had beautiful weather all week.
examples.cn: 我们整周都遇上好天气。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 beautiful 拆成 beauty 加 ful，就是「满满都是美」。

root: 由 beauty 加形容词后缀 -ful 构成；beauty 源自拉丁语 bellus「漂亮」，经古法语 beaute 进入英语，核心义为「充满美的」。

sensesIntro.en: Looks and sounds can both be called beautiful.
sensesIntro.cn: 外表与声音都可以用 beautiful 形容。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lake turned gold by the setting sun.
core.cn: 核心意象：夕阳染成金红的湖面。

intro.en: Beautiful is beauty plus -ful, and takes -ly for the adverb.
intro.cn: beautiful 由 beauty 加 -ful 构成，加 -ly 得副词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is bellus, pretty.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基是 bellus，意为「漂亮」。

definition_en: the quality of being beautiful, or a beautiful woman
core_image: 清晨花瓣上还未散去的露珠
scene: 露水在花瓣边缘聚成一颗。The beauty of the garden surprised every visitor.
sceneCN: 这里 beauty 是「美」（第 1 个义项：使人愉悦的品质）；句意是花园之美让每位访客惊叹。

derivatives.zh: 由 beauty 加 -ful 构成，义为「美丽的」
由 beauty 加 -fy 构成，义为「美化」
由 beauty 与 -ician 构成，义为「美容师」

senses.title: The quality of being beautiful
senses.definition: the quality that gives pleasure to the senses
senses.definitionCN: 使感官愉悦的品质
senses.example: The beauty of the garden surprised every visitor.
senses.exampleCN: 花园之美让每位访客惊叹。
senses.why: The word came through French from Latin bellus, pretty.
senses.whyCN: 这个词经法语来自拉丁语 bellus「漂亮」。

senses.title: A beautiful woman or thing
senses.definition: a beautiful woman or a very fine example
senses.definitionCN: 美丽的女子或极出色的实例
senses.example: The old car is a real beauty.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆旧车真是件美物。
senses.why: The abstract quality was applied to the person or thing that shows it.
senses.whyCN: 抽象的品质被用来指体现它的美人或美物。

senses.title: The special advantage
senses.definition: the pleasing or useful feature of something
senses.definitionCN: 某事物令人愉快或有用的特点
senses.example: The beauty of it is that it costs nothing.
senses.exampleCN: 它的妙处在于不花一分钱。
senses.why: The sense of charm widened to any attractive advantage.
senses.whyCN: 「魅力」义扩展到任何吸引人的优点。

intro.en: Beauty came through French from a Latin word for pretty.
intro.cn: beauty 经法语来自拉丁语中表示「漂亮」的词。

items.en: bellus meant pretty or fine.
bel meant handsome or fair.
beaute named the quality of beauty.
beaute entered English as beauty.
items.cn: beaute 进入英语，写作 beauty。

items.en: beauty covers looks, people and advantages.
items.cn: 如今 beauty 兼指外貌、美人与优点。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the same stem; the near-meaning group gives other words for charm.
note.cn: 形近组共享同一词干；近义组是其他表示魅力的词。

normalIntro.en: Beauty is the quality behind beautiful.
normalIntro.cn: beauty 是 beautiful 背后的那种品质。

normal.en: The plural is beauties.
Beautiful is beauty plus -ful.
Beautify means to make beautiful.
A beauty salon is a place for personal care.
The beauty of it means its special advantage.
normal.cn: the beauty of it 指它的妙处。

abstract.en: See dew resting on a petal.
abstract.cn: 想象停在花瓣上的露珠。

abstract.en: See a face that makes people turn.
abstract.cn: 想象一张让人回头的脸。

abstract.en: See a simple plan with one clear advantage.
abstract.cn: 想象一个有一个明显优点的简单方案。

examples.en: The beauty of the garden surprised every visitor.
examples.cn: 花园之美让每位访客惊叹。

examples.en: The old car is a real beauty.
examples.cn: 这辆旧车真是件美物。

examples.en: The beauty of it is that it costs nothing.
examples.cn: 它的妙处在于不花一分钱。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 beauty 想成清晨花瓣上那颗还没散去的露珠。

root: 源自拉丁语 bellus「漂亮」，经古法语 beaute 进入英语；由抽象的「美」引申指美人、美物，再引申为事物的「妙处」。

sensesIntro.en: The quality of beauty, the person who has it, and the advantage it brings.
sensesIntro.cn: 美的品质、拥有美的人，以及它带来的好处。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: dew still resting on a petal.
core.cn: 核心意象：花瓣上未散的露珠。

intro.en: Beauty takes -ful, -fy and -ician to build new words.
intro.cn: beauty 可加 -ful、-fy、-ician 构成新词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is bellus, pretty.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基是 bellus，意为「漂亮」。

items.meaning: a person who cares for beauty

definition_en: for the reason that
core_image: 一扇门被推开，屋里的灯亮着
scene: 雨越下越大，我们只好留在屋里。We stayed inside because it was raining.
sceneCN: 这里 because 是「因为」（第 1 个义项：引出原因从句）；句意是因为下雨，我们留在了屋里。

derivatives.zh: 与 because 同源，义为「原因」
由 cause 加 -al 构成，义为「因果的」

senses.title: For the reason that
senses.definition: used to introduce the reason for something
senses.definitionCN: 用来引出某事的原因
senses.example: We stayed inside because it was raining.
senses.exampleCN: 因为下雨，我们留在了屋里。
senses.why: The word shrank from the phrase by cause of, meaning for the reason of.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由短语 by cause of「由于……的原因」缩合而来。

senses.title: With a noun after of
senses.definition: used with of before a noun or pronoun
senses.definitionCN: 与 of 连用，后接名词或代词
senses.example: The game was cancelled because of the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 比赛因雨取消了。
senses.why: Because of kept the noun use of the old phrase by cause of.
senses.whyCN: because of 保留了旧短语 by cause of 接名词的用法。

intro.en: Because is a worn-down phrase: by cause.
intro.cn: because 是一个磨损缩合的短语，原为 by cause。

items.en: causa meant a reason or a case.
cause meant a reason.
by cause of meant for the reason of.
items.cn: by cause of 意为「由于……的原因」。

items.en: the phrase shrank into bicause.
because became the usual reason word.
items.cn: because 成为常用的原因连词。

note.en: The look-alike group begins with be-; the near-meaning group gives other reason words.
note.cn: 形近组都以 be- 开头；近义组是其他表示原因的词。

normalIntro.en: Because introduces a reason, and because of introduces a noun.
normalIntro.cn: because 引出原因从句，because of 后接名词。

normal.en: Because is one word, unlike be cause.
normal.cn: because 是一个词，不分开写。

normal.en: Because of comes before a noun.
Just because means for that reason alone.
The word came from by cause.
Cause is the noun hidden inside.
normal.cn: cause 是藏在其中的名词。

abstract.en: See a door opening onto a lit room.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门通向亮着灯的房间。

abstract.en: See rain running down a window.
abstract.cn: 想象雨水顺着窗户流下。

abstract.en: See an arrow pointing from result to cause.
abstract.cn: 想象一支从结果指向原因的箭头。

examples.en: We stayed inside because it was raining.
examples.cn: 因为下雨，我们留在了屋里。

examples.en: The game was cancelled because of the rain.
examples.cn: 比赛因雨取消了。

examples.en: She left early because she felt ill.
examples.cn: 她因为不舒服提早离开了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 because 拆成 be 加 cause，就是「原因就在这里」。

root: 由中古英语短语 by cause of「由于……的原因」缩合而成，cause 源自拉丁语 causa「原因、事由」，核心作用是引出原因。

sensesIntro.en: One word for a clause, and one phrase for a noun.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个词引出从句，一个短语后接名词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a door opening onto a lit room.
core.cn: 核心意象：通向亮灯房间的一扇门。

intro.en: Because is a fixed word, but its hidden noun cause builds new words.
intro.cn: because 是固定词，但其中的 cause 能构成新词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is causa, a reason.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基是 causa，意为「原因」。

definition_en: to begin to be something, or to suit someone
core_image: 一颗种子顶开泥土，伸出一片新叶
scene: 天边的云慢慢染上了金色。The sky became golden at sunset.
sceneCN: 这里 become 是「变成」（第 1 个义项：开始成为某种状态）；句意是日落时天空变成了金色。

derivatives.zh: 由 become 加 -ing 构成，义为「合适的」
由 un- 与 becoming 构成，义为「不合适的」

senses.title: To begin to be a state
senses.definition: to begin to have a new quality or state
senses.definitionCN: 开始具有新的性质或状态
senses.example: The sky became golden at sunset.
senses.exampleCN: 日落时天空变成了金色。
senses.why: The word first meant to come to a place, then to come to a state.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指「来到某地」，后来指「进入某种状态」。

senses.title: To grow into a role
senses.definition: to grow into an identity or role
senses.definitionCN: 成长为某种身份或角色
senses.example: She became a doctor after years of study.
senses.exampleCN: 多年学习后她成了一名医生。
senses.why: Coming to a state widened to coming to a lasting identity.
senses.whyCN: 「进入状态」扩展到「成为持久的身份」。

senses.title: To suit someone
senses.definition: to look good on someone or suit them
senses.definitionCN: 穿在某人身上好看或与其相称
senses.example: That colour becomes you.
senses.exampleCN: 那个颜色很适合你。
senses.why: The idea of fitting a state grew into fitting a person.
senses.whyCN: 「与状态相合」引申为「与人相称」。

intro.en: Become is be- plus come, and first meant to arrive.
intro.cn: become 由 be- 与 come 构成，最初意为「到达」。

items.en: cuman meant to come.
becuman meant to arrive or come to.
bicomen came to mean to come to be.
items.cn: bicomen 开始表示「逐渐成为」。

items.en: become covered states and roles.
items.cn: become 兼指状态与身份的变化。

items.en: become also means to suit.
items.cn: 如今 become 还表示「适合」。

note.en: The look-alike group begins with be-; the near-meaning group gives other change verbs.
note.cn: 形近组都以 be- 开头；近义组是其他表示变化的动词。

entries.definition: to act in a certain way

normalIntro.en: Become means to come into a new state, role or fit.
normalIntro.cn: become 指进入新的状态、身份或相称关系。

normal.en: The past tense is became.
The past participle is become.
Becoming can mean suitable.
Become clear means to turn clear.
What became of him asks about his fate.
normal.cn: what became of him 是问他后来怎样了。

abstract.en: See a seed pushing up through soil.
abstract.cn: 想象种子顶开泥土。

abstract.en: See a sky turning gold.
abstract.cn: 想象天空转为金色。

abstract.en: See a coat fitting a shoulder.
abstract.cn: 想象外套贴合肩膀。

examples.en: The sky became golden at sunset.
examples.cn: 日落时天空变成了金色。

examples.en: She became a doctor after years of study.
examples.cn: 多年学习后她成了一名医生。

examples.en: That colour becomes you.
examples.cn: 那个颜色很适合你。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 become 想成「走来（come）并停在某个新样子上」。

root: 由古英语 be- 与 cuman「来」构成 becuman「到达」，中古英语引申为「逐渐成为」，现代又扩展出「适合、相称」之义。

sensesIntro.en: Arriving at a place became arriving at a state.
sensesIntro.cn: 「到达某地」逐渐引申为「进入某种状态」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a seed pushing a new leaf out of the soil.
core.cn: 核心意象：种子顶开泥土伸出新叶。

intro.en: Become takes be- and -ing, and the prefix un- for the adjective.
intro.cn: become 含前缀 be-，加 -ing 成形容词，再加 un- 表否定。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the word is Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，这个词来自古英语。

definition_en: a piece of furniture for sleeping, or a flat base such as a river bed
core_image: 铺着白色床单、被子掀开一角的木床
scene: 窗帘被风吹得轻轻鼓起。She lay on the bed and closed her eyes.
sceneCN: 这里 bed 是「床」（第 1 个义项：供人睡觉的家具）；句意是她躺在床上闭上了眼睛。

derivatives.zh: 由 bed 加 -ding 构成，义为「床上用品」
由 bed 与 room 复合，义为「卧室」
由 bed 与 side 复合，义为「床边」

senses.title: Furniture for sleeping
senses.definition: a piece of furniture used for sleeping
senses.definitionCN: 供人睡觉的家具
senses.example: She lay on the bed and closed her eyes.
senses.exampleCN: 她躺在床上闭上了眼睛。
senses.why: This is the old sense, from a Germanic word for a sleeping place.
senses.whyCN: 这是古老的义项，来自日耳曼语中表示睡卧处的词。

senses.title: A flat bottom
senses.definition: the flat bottom of a river or the sea
senses.definitionCN: 河流或海洋的平坦底部
senses.example: The river bed was dry in summer.
senses.exampleCN: 夏天河床干涸了。
senses.why: The flat shape of a bed was borrowed for the bottom of water.
senses.whyCN: 床的平坦形状被借用来指水底。

senses.title: A planted area
senses.definition: an area of ground where flowers are grown
senses.definitionCN: 种植花卉的一块土地
senses.example: Tulips filled the flower bed.
senses.exampleCN: 花坛里开满了郁金香。
senses.why: A raised flat plot looked like a bed, so gardeners used the word.
senses.whyCN: 平整而略高的地块像一张床，园艺中便沿用了这个词。

intro.en: Bed is an old Germanic word for a place to sleep.
intro.cn: bed 是一个古老的日耳曼词，指睡觉的地方。

items.en: bedd meant a sleeping place.
bed also named a flat plot of ground.
items.cn: bed 也指一块平整的土地。

items.en: bed named the bottom of a river.
bed joined room and side in compounds.
items.cn: bed 与 room、side 构成复合词。

items.en: bed covers furniture, ground and water bottoms.
items.cn: 如今 bed 兼指家具、地块与水底。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one vowel; the near-meaning group gives other sleeping furniture.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个元音；近义组是其他睡卧家具。

entries.definition: a small bed for a child
a long soft seat for resting

normalIntro.en: A bed is for sleeping, and the same flat shape names river bottoms and flower plots.
normalIntro.cn: bed 是睡觉的家具，同样的平坦形状也指河底与花坛。

normal.en: The plural is beds.
Go to bed means go to sleep.
normal.cn: go to bed 指去睡觉。

normal.en: Make the bed means tidy the covers.
A river bed is the bottom of a river.
Bedroom is bed plus room.
normal.cn: bedroom 是 bed 加 room。

abstract.en: See a white sheet folded back.
abstract.cn: 想象掀开一角的白色床单。

abstract.en: See a dry river channel.
abstract.cn: 想象干涸的河道。

abstract.en: See a strip of tulips in a garden.
abstract.cn: 想象花园里一条郁金香花带。

examples.en: She lay on the bed and closed her eyes.
examples.cn: 她躺在床上闭上了眼睛。

examples.en: The river bed was dry in summer.
examples.cn: 夏天河床干涸了。

examples.en: Tulips filled the flower bed.
examples.cn: 花坛里开满了郁金香。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 bed 想成一块平整的软垫，床、河底、花坛都是平的。

root: 古英语 bedd 指睡卧之处，属日耳曼语词汇；由「平坦的睡卧面」引申指河床、海床与平整的花坛。

sensesIntro.en: A sleeping place, a flat bottom and a planted plot share one flat shape.
sensesIntro.cn: 睡卧处、平坦底部与种植地块，共用同一种平坦形状。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wooden bed with a white sheet folded back.
core.cn: 核心意象：铺白床单、掀开一角的木床。

intro.en: Bed takes -s and -ding, and joins room and side.
intro.cn: bed 可加 -s、-ding，也能与 room、side 复合。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，这个词来自日耳曼语。

definition_en: a room used for sleeping
core_image: 拉上窗帘的卧室里只有床头灯亮着
scene: 走廊尽头那扇门半开着。The bedroom was quiet and dark.
sceneCN: 这里 bedroom 是「卧室」（第 1 个义项：供人睡觉的房间）；句意是卧室里安静而昏暗。

pos.zh: 形容词：卧室的（用于复合词）

derivatives.zh: 由 bedroom 加 -ed 构成，义为「有若干间卧室的」
bedroom 的基础词，义为「床」

senses.title: A room for sleeping
senses.definition: a room in a house used for sleeping
senses.definitionCN: 房屋中供人睡觉的房间
senses.example: The bedroom was quiet and dark.
senses.exampleCN: 卧室里安静而昏暗。
senses.why: The word is a plain compound of bed and room.
senses.whyCN: 这个词就是 bed 与 room 的简单复合。

senses.title: A count of sleeping rooms
senses.definition: used in compounds to count sleeping rooms
senses.definitionCN: 用于复合词中表示卧室的数量
senses.example: They rented a two-bedroom flat.
senses.exampleCN: 他们租了一套两居室公寓。
senses.why: Housing descriptions turned the room name into a counting word.
senses.whyCN: 房屋描述把这个房间名变成了计数用词。

intro.en: Bedroom is a compound of bed and room.
intro.cn: bedroom 是 bed 与 room 的复合词。

items.en: bedd meant a sleeping place.
rum meant space or a room.
bedroom named a room for sleeping.
the word entered housing descriptions.
bedroom counts rooms in flats and houses.
items.cn: 如今 bedroom 用于统计住宅的卧室数。

note.en: The look-alike group shares room or bed; the near-meaning group gives other rooms.
note.cn: 形近组共享 room 或 bed；近义组是其他房间词。

entries.definition: a room with a bath or shower
a room, often a private one

normalIntro.en: A bedroom is simply the room with the bed.
normalIntro.cn: bedroom 就是放床的那个房间。

normal.en: The plural is bedrooms.
A spare bedroom is an unused one.
normal.cn: a spare bedroom 指空着的卧室。

normal.en: A two-bedroom flat has two sleeping rooms.
normal.cn: a two-bedroom flat 指两居室。

normal.en: Bedroomed describes a house with rooms.
normal.cn: bedroomed 形容有若干卧室的房子。

normal.en: The word is bed plus room.
normal.cn: 这个词是 bed 加 room。

abstract.en: See a dim lamp beside a curtained window.
abstract.cn: 想象窗帘边一盏昏暗的灯。

abstract.en: See a half-open door at a corridor's end.
abstract.cn: 想象走廊尽头半开的门。

abstract.en: See a quiet room with a made bed.
abstract.cn: 想象一间铺好床的安静房间。

examples.en: The bedroom was quiet and dark.
examples.cn: 卧室里安静而昏暗。

examples.en: They rented a two-bedroom flat.
examples.cn: 他们租了一套两居室公寓。

examples.en: She opened the bedroom window.
examples.cn: 她打开了卧室的窗户。

dict_mnemonic.text: bed 加 room，放床的房间就是卧室。

root: 由古英语 bedd「睡卧处」与 rum「空间、房间」复合而成，十七世纪起专指供睡觉的房间，现代又用于表示住宅的卧室数量。

sensesIntro.en: The room itself, and the count of such rooms in a home.
sensesIntro.cn: 既指卧室本身，也指住宅中卧室的数量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dim bedroom lit by one bedside lamp.
core.cn: 核心意象：只有床头灯亮着的昏暗卧室。

intro.en: Bedroom takes -s and -ed, and is built from bed and room.
intro.cn: bedroom 可加 -s、-ed，本身由 bed 与 room 构成。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; both parts are Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，两个组成部分都来自古英语。

definition_en: the meat of a cow, or a complaint
core_image: 铁锅里煎着厚厚一块带纹理的牛排
scene: 厨房里传出油花爆响的声音。He grilled a thick piece of beef.
sceneCN: 这里 beef 是「牛肉」（第 1 个义项：牛的肉）；句意是他烤了一块厚牛肉。

derivatives.zh: 由 beef 加 -y 构成，义为「结实的」
由 beef 与 steak 复合，义为「牛排」

senses.title: The meat of a cow
senses.definition: the meat of a cow used as food
senses.definitionCN: 供食用的牛的肉
senses.example: He grilled a thick piece of beef.
senses.exampleCN: 他烤了一块厚牛肉。
senses.why: The word came through French from Latin bos, an ox or cow.
senses.whyCN: 这个词经法语来自拉丁语 bos「牛」。

senses.title: A complaint
senses.definition: a complaint or a strong objection
senses.definitionCN: 抱怨或强烈的不满
senses.example: He has a beef with the new rules.
senses.exampleCN: 他对新规定有意见。
senses.why: American slang turned the solid meat word into a word for a solid complaint.
senses.whyCN: 美国俚语把表示实在肉块的词转用来指实实在在的不满。

intro.en: Beef came through French from the Latin word for an ox.
intro.cn: beef 经法语来自拉丁语中表示牛的字。

items.en: bos meant an ox or a cow.
buef meant an ox.
beef named the meat of cattle.
beef gained the slang sense of a complaint.
items.cn: beef 获得「抱怨」的俚语义。

items.en: beef means meat and also a grievance.
items.cn: 如今 beef 兼指牛肉与不满。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one sound; the near-meaning group gives other meat words.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个音；近义组是其他肉类词。

entries.definition: a flying insect that makes honey
the flesh of an animal as food
the meat of a young cow

normalIntro.en: Beef is cow meat, and in slang it is also a complaint.
normalIntro.cn: beef 是牛肉，俚语里也指不满。

normal.en: Beef is usually uncountable as meat.
normal.cn: 作肉类时 beef 通常不可数。

normal.en: The plural beefs is used for complaints.
normal.cn: 复数 beefs 用于「抱怨」。

normal.en: Beef steak is a thick slice of beef.
Ground beef is minced beef.
Have a beef with means to be annoyed at.
normal.cn: have a beef with 指对……有意见。

abstract.en: See a thick steak hissing in a pan.
abstract.cn: 想象厚牛排在下锅时滋滋作响。

abstract.en: See a butcher lifting a red cut.
abstract.cn: 想象屠夫提起一块红肉。

abstract.en: See a person frowning at a new rule.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人对着新规定皱眉。

examples.en: He grilled a thick piece of beef.
examples.cn: 他烤了一块厚牛肉。

examples.en: He has a beef with the new rules.
examples.cn: 他对新规定有意见。

examples.en: She bought ground beef for the sauce.
examples.cn: 她买了碎牛肉做酱。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 beef 想成锅里那块厚实的牛肉，抱怨也像一块咽不下的硬肉。

root: 源自拉丁语 bos「牛」，经古法语 buef 进入中古英语，专指牛肉；十九世纪美国俚语又用它表示「不满、抱怨」。

sensesIntro.en: A solid cut of meat, and a solid complaint.

senses.title: A glass or serving of beer
senses.definition: a glass or bottle of beer

senses.example: We ordered two beers.

intro.cn: beer 可追溯到拉丁语中表示饮料的词。

beor meant a strong drink.

normal.en: Two beers means two servings.
Draft beer comes from a barrel.

normal.en: Go for a beer means go out to drink.

abstract.en: See friends at a small table on a summer night.

sensesIntro.en: The drink itself, and one serving of it.

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is biber, a drink.

definition_en: earlier than something, or in front of
core_image: 天还没亮，厨房的灯先亮了
scene: 闹钟还没响，他就已经醒了。He left before the sun rose.
sceneCN: 这里 before 是「在……之前」（第 1 个义项：时间上早于某事）；句意是太阳升起之前他就离开了。

derivatives.zh: 由 before 与 hand 复合，义为「事先」
与 before 同源，义为「前部的」

senses.title: Earlier in time
senses.definition: earlier than a time or event
senses.definitionCN: 时间上早于某个时刻或事件
senses.example: He left before the sun rose.
senses.exampleCN: 太阳升起之前他就离开了。
senses.why: The word was built from be- and an old word for in front.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由 be- 与一个表示「在前面」的旧词构成。

senses.title: In front of
senses.definition: in front of someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 在某人的前面或某物的前面
senses.example: She stood before the door.
senses.exampleCN: 她站在门前。
senses.why: Time and place shared one word, since what is ahead comes first.
senses.whyCN: 时间与空间共用一个词，因为「在前」也就意味着「在先」。

senses.title: At an earlier time
senses.definition: at an earlier time, used alone
senses.definitionCN: 单独使用，表示过去某个更早的时候
senses.example: I have met him before.
senses.exampleCN: 我以前见过他。
senses.why: The adverb use grew from the same idea of being earlier.
senses.whyCN: 副词用法同样来自「更早」这一概念。

intro.en: Before is an old compound meaning in front.
intro.cn: before 是一个古老的复合词，意为「在前面」。

items.en: foran meant in front.
beforan meant in front of.
beforan shrank to before.
before covered both time and place.
before works as preposition, conjunction and adverb.
items.cn: 如今 before 可作介词、连词与副词。

note.en: The look-alike group begins with be-; the near-meaning group gives words for earlier or ahead.
note.cn: 形近组都以 be- 开头；近义组表示更早或在前。

normalIntro.en: Before marks what comes earlier, in time or in place.
normalIntro.cn: before 标记更早发生的事，或更靠前的位置。

normal.en: Before dawn means earlier than sunrise.
The day before means the previous day.
normal.cn: the day before 指前一天。

normal.en: Before long means soon.
Beforehand means in advance.
The word is unchanged in form.

abstract.en: See a kitchen light on before sunrise.
abstract.cn: 想象日出前亮起的厨房灯。

abstract.en: See a person waiting in front of a door.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人等在门前。

abstract.en: See a remembered face from long ago.
abstract.cn: 想象很久以前见过的一张脸。

examples.en: He left before the sun rose.
examples.cn: 太阳升起之前他就离开了。

examples.en: She stood before the door.
examples.cn: 她站在门前。

examples.en: I have met him before.
examples.cn: 我以前见过他。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 before 想成「站在时间的前面」，先到的那一步。

root: 由古英语 be- 与 foran「在前面」构成 beforan「在……前面」，中古英语缩合为 before，同时用于时间与空间，并发展出副词「以前」。

sensesIntro.en: Earlier in time, in front in space, and earlier on its own.
sensesIntro.cn: 时间上更早、空间上在前，以及单独使用的「以前」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a kitchen light already on before sunrise.
core.cn: 核心意象：日出前就先亮起的厨房灯。

intro.en: Before is a fixed word, and it builds beforehand.
intro.cn: before 是固定词，可与 hand 构成 beforehand。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the word is Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，这个词来自古英语。

items.meaning: earlier than or in front of

definition_en: earlier than a particular time, event, or action; in advance
core_image: 事情还没发生，手已经先伸到前面去了：把准备做在时间的前头
scene: 开会前她把资料全都打印装订好了，等大家到场就能直接讨论，一点不慌乱。She prepared all the documents beforehand, so the meeting went smoothly.
sceneCN: 这里 beforehand 是「事先、预先」（第 1 个义项：早于某个时间或事件发生）；句意是她在会议开始之前就把资料准备好了，因此会议进行得很顺利。

derivatives.zh: 由「after（之后）+ hand」构成的对应词，义为「事后」（罕用，多见于早期英语）
由 beforehand 加名词后缀构成的罕用名词，义为「预先性；提前状态」
相关近义词，义为「前进；预先」（in advance 短语与 beforehand 同义）

senses.title: Earlier than a particular time or event
senses.titleCN: 事先；在某个时间或事件之前
senses.definition: at an earlier time than something happens or is done
senses.definitionCN: 在事情发生或完成之前的时间点上
senses.example: She prepared all the documents beforehand.
senses.exampleCN: 她事先把所有文件都准备好了。
senses.why: The compound joins before with hand, as if time were held and handled before the moment arrives.
senses.whyCN: 复合词把 before（在前）和 hand（手）组合起来，仿佛时间被握在手里、先一步递到事情发生之前。

senses.title: In advance, as a preparation
senses.definition: in advance so that one is ready when the time comes
senses.definitionCN: 提前安排妥当，等到关键时刻不至于手忙脚乱
senses.example: If you book the tickets beforehand, you will pay less.
senses.exampleCN: 如果你提前订票，价格会便宜一些。
senses.why: Doing the work in advance shifts effort from the busy moment to the calm one before it.
senses.whyCN: 把功夫下在前头，等于把忙碌时刻的工作挪到之前从容的时段里完成。

senses.title: Before doing something else, as a first step
senses.definition: as a prior step before moving on to something else
senses.definitionCN: 作为先行的步骤，把某事处理完再谈下一步
senses.example: Read the contract beforehand before you sign it.
senses.exampleCN: 签字之前要先读一遍合同。
senses.why: The word marks sequence: one action must be handled ahead of another.
senses.whyCN: 这个词标记先后顺序：一件事必须先于另一件事处理。

senses.title: Ahead of other people, earlier than others
senses.definition: earlier than other people manage to do or know something
senses.definitionCN: 在别人之前完成或了解到某事
senses.example: He knew the result beforehand because he had seen the list.
senses.exampleCN: 他提前知道了结果，因为他看过名单。
senses.why: Being ahead in time also means being ahead of everyone else who waits.
senses.whyCN: 在时间上领先，也意味着领先于那些还在等待的人。

senses.title: With advance knowledge or notice
senses.titleCN: 预先获知；事先得到消息
senses.definition: with knowledge of something before it is announced or happens
senses.definitionCN: 在事情公布或发生之前就已知晓
senses.example: Nobody told me beforehand that the plan had changed.
senses.exampleCN: 事先没有人告诉我计划变了。
senses.why: Information received early lets a person act as if the future were already in hand.
senses.whyCN: 提前拿到信息，就像把未来的事情先握在手里一样。

senses.title: In prior arrangement or agreement
senses.definition: as something arranged or agreed before the occasion itself
senses.definitionCN: 指在正式场合之前就已经谈好、定好的安排
senses.example: We had agreed beforehand to split the cost equally.
senses.exampleCN: 我们事先说好了平摊费用。
senses.why: An agreement made ahead binds both sides before the event arrives.
senses.whyCN: 事先达成的约定在事情到来之前就已约束双方。

senses.title: Anticipating future needs, planning ahead
senses.titleCN: 未雨绸缪地；为将来打算
senses.definition: with thought given to future needs before they arise
senses.definitionCN: 在需求出现之前就预作打算
senses.example: Thinking beforehand about possible problems saved the team a lot of trouble.
senses.exampleCN: 提前考虑可能出现的问题，为团队省去了很多麻烦。
senses.why: The mind reaches forward in time, handling tomorrow's tasks today.
senses.whyCN: 思绪提前伸向未来，把明天的事拿到今天来处理。

senses.title: In negative and interrogative uses, impossibility of prior knowledge
senses.titleCN: 用于否定或疑问：无法事先知道
senses.definition: used to say that something could not be known or done in advance
senses.definitionCN: 常用于否定句或疑问句，表示某事无法预先知道或做到
senses.example: I could not have known beforehand that the flight would be cancelled.
senses.exampleCN: 我事先不可能知道航班会被取消。
senses.why: Negation flips the image: the hand did not reach forward, so surprise follows.
senses.whyCN: 否定翻转了意象：手没有先伸出去，于是意外接踵而来。

intro.en: Beforehand is a native English compound of before plus hand, formed within Middle English and parallel to the rarer afterhand.
intro.cn: beforehand 是英语本土复合词，由 before（在前）加 hand（手）构成，形成于中古英语时期，与罕用的 afterhand（事后）相对应。

items.en: Before comes from Old English beforan, itself be- (by, about) plus foran (in front of), a spatial word later extended to time.
items.cn: before 源自古英语 beforan，由 be-（在、关于）加 foran（在前方）构成，原本表示空间方位，后来引申为时间上的先后。

items.en: Hand is a common Germanic noun, Old English hand, found in many compound expressions for possession and action.
items.cn: hand 是常见的日耳曼语名词，古英语作 hand，在英语中大量出现于表示掌握、动作的复合表达里。

items.en: The compound beforehand is first recorded in the late fourteenth century, meaning at an earlier point or in front.
items.cn: 复合词 beforehand 最早见于十四世纪晚期，意为「在更早的时点；在前方」。

items.en: The sense narrows to in advance, in anticipation, and the word settles into its modern adverbial use alongside the rare parallel afterhand.
items.cn: 词义逐渐收窄为「提前、预先」，该词固定为现代副词用法，与罕用的对应词 afterhand（事后）并存。

items.en: Today beforehand is the standard adverb for doing or knowing something in advance, common in both everyday and formal contexts.
items.cn: 如今 beforehand 是表示「事先、预先」的标准副词，日常与正式语体中都十分常用。

note.en: The first group gathers words built from the same before- and fore- material; the second gathers near-synonymous ways of saying in advance.
note.cn: 第一组收录由 before-、fore- 等相同材料构成的词；第二组收录表示「提前、预先」的近义说法。

entries.definition: a stroke made with the palm of the hand facing forward; shares the -hand element but means a forward hand position, not time
entries.definitionCN: 正手；与 beforehand 共享 -hand 成分，但指手掌朝前的击球方式，与时间无关，只是构词相近。

entries.definition: a system of quick writing using symbols; ends in -hand like beforehand but refers to a shortened hand method, not time
entries.definitionCN: 速记；与 beforehand 一样以 -hand 结尾，但指缩略的书写方法，只是构词方式相似，词义不同。

entries.definition: the rare mirror compound meaning afterward; built with -hand exactly like beforehand but pointing the other way in time
entries.definitionCN: 事后（罕用）；与 beforehand 用同样方式以 -hand 构成的镜像词，只是时间方向相反。

entries.definition: ahead of the time when something happens; the common phrase-level equivalent of beforehand
entries.definitionCN: 提前；beforehand 最常见的短语级同义表达。

entries.definition: too early, before the proper time; adds a nuance of being earlier than is right
entries.definitionCN: 过早地；提前得不止一步而是过了头，带有不合时宜的贬义色彩。

entries.definition: earlier than the expected or required time
entries.definitionCN: 比预期或要求的时间早；与 beforehand 同义而更口语化。

normalIntro.en: The five associations below build on the real compound before plus hand.
normalIntro.cn: 以下五条联想都基于真实的复合结构 before（在前）加 hand（手）。

normal.en: before + hand: your hand reaches before the moment arrives
normal.cn: before 加 hand：手先伸到时刻到来之前

normal.en: beforehand and afterhand are a pair, one ahead and one behind
normal.cn: beforehand 与 afterhand 是一对，一个在前一个在后

normal.en: before itself is be- plus foran, in front
normal.cn: before 本身由 be- 加 foran 构成，义为在前方

normal.en: same family: before, beforelong, beforehand all point earlier in time
normal.cn: 同族词：before、beforelong、beforehand 都指向更早的时间

normal.en: collocation anchor: know beforehand, plan beforehand, prepare beforehand
normal.cn: 搭配锚点：know beforehand（事先知道）、plan beforehand（预先计划）、prepare beforehand（提前准备）

abstract.en: Picture posting the letter a day before the deadline, the queue already behind you
abstract.cn: 想象在截止日前一天就把信寄出，队伍还没排起来你已办完

abstract.en: Feel the calm of a packed suitcase by the door the night before travel
abstract.cn: 感受出发前夜行李箱已收好立在门边的那份从容

abstract.en: Imagine holding tomorrow in your hand today
abstract.cn: 想象今天就把明天握在手里

examples.en: If you book the tickets beforehand, you will pay less.
examples.cn: 如果你提前订票，价格会便宜一些。

examples.en: Nobody told me beforehand that the plan had changed.
examples.cn: 事先没有人告诉我计划变了。

examples.en: The notice arrived late, so there was no time to prepare.
examples.cn: 通知来得很晚，根本没时间准备。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「必福汉德」——必先福在手：福气要先握在手里，事情就能顺利，正如 beforehand 强调事先把一切安排妥当。

root: 英语本土复合词：before（源自古英语 beforan，be- 加 foran「在前」）+ hand（古英语 hand「手」），十四世纪晚期合成，义为「在事前、提前」，与罕用的 afterhand（事后）相对应。

sensesIntro.en: From the core image of reaching ahead in time, the senses move from simple priority to preparation, prior knowledge, prior agreement, and the negative case of not knowing in advance.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「把手伸到时间前头」的核心意象出发，义项由单纯的时间领先，扩展到预先准备、预先知情、事先约定，以及否定用法中的「无法预知」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the hand reaching before the moment, doing and knowing ahead of time
core.cn: 核心意象：手伸到时刻到来之前，把事情先做好、先知道

branches.en: Sheer time priority, ahead of the event or of other people
branches.cn: 单纯的时间领先，早于事件或早于他人

branches.en: Preparation done in advance so the moment goes smoothly
branches.cn: 提前做好准备，让关键时刻从容不迫

branches.en: Prior steps and agreements that bind before the occasion
branches.cn: 先行步骤与事先约定，在场合到来之前就定好

branches.en: Advance knowledge and its failure, knowing or not knowing in advance
branches.cn: 预先知情及其反面，知道或无法事先知道
为将来需求预作打算的远虑

intro.en: Beforehand is a compound, not an affixed word, so the items below cover its building blocks and the parallel time-words formed the same way.
intro.cn: beforehand 是复合词而非派生词，因此下列条目介绍它的构件，以及按同样方式构成的时间类平行词。

latinIntro.en: English has no Latin root here, but Latin ante (before) and manus (hand) offer classical parallels to the two parts of the compound.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁语词根，但拉丁语 ante（在前）与 manus（手）恰好对应复合词的两个部分，可作古典参照。

items.meaning: the hand, used figuratively for control or action
items.example: The matter is in hand now.
items.exampleCN: 这件事现在已在处理之中。

items.example: The garden is beflowered in spring.
Check the forecast before you sail.

items.exampleCN: 后来我们谈起了这件事。

items.meaning: to see something before it happens
items.example: No one could foresee the delay.
items.exampleCN: 没人能预见到这次延误。

latinEntries.exampleCN: ante meridiem 意为中午之前。

latinEntries.example: Manuscript originally meant written by hand.
latinEntries.exampleCN: manuscript 一词原义是用手写成。

derivatives.zh: 由 fore-（预先）加 knowledge（知识）构成，义为「预知；预知能力」

definition_en: to start doing something or to start happening
core_image: 跑道上运动员弯腰等待发令枪
scene: 发令枪还没响，跑道上一片安静。The race will begin at noon.
sceneCN: 这里 begin 是「开始」（第 1 个义项：开始做某事或开始发生）；句意是比赛将在中午开始。

derivatives.zh: 由 begin 加 -ning 构成，义为「开始」
由 begin 加 -ner 构成，义为「初学者」

senses.title: To start doing or happening
senses.definition: to start an action or an event
senses.definitionCN: 开始某个动作或事件
senses.example: The race will begin at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 比赛将在中午开始。
senses.why: The word was built from be- and an old verb meaning to open or start.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由 be- 与一个意为「开启、开始」的旧动词构成。

senses.title: To start from something
senses.definition: to have something as the first part
senses.definitionCN: 以某事物作为第一部分
senses.example: The course begins with the basics.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课从基础开始。
senses.why: The phrase begin with arose from the idea of a first point.
senses.whyCN: begin with 这一搭配来自「起始点」的概念。

intro.en: Begin is an Old English compound of be- and a verb for starting.
intro.cn: begin 是古英语中由 be- 与表示开始的动词构成的复合词。

items.en: ginnan meant to begin.
beginnan meant to begin or undertake.
biginne kept the same sense.
begin settled into its modern forms.
begin is one of the commonest verbs of starting.
items.cn: 如今 begin 是最常用的「开始」动词之一。

note.en: The look-alike group shares be- or a similar sound; the near-meaning group gives other start verbs.
note.cn: 形近组共享 be- 或相近读音；近义组是其他表示开始的动词。

normalIntro.en: Begin means to start, and begin with names the first part.
normalIntro.cn: begin 指开始，begin with 指以某物作为开头。

normal.en: The past tense is began.
The past participle is begun.
The present participle is beginning, with double n.
normal.cn: 现在分词是 beginning，双写 n。

normal.en: To begin with means firstly.
A beginner is a person who is starting.

abstract.en: See a runner bent at the starting line.
abstract.cn: 想象跑道上弯腰的运动员。

abstract.en: See a gun about to sound.
abstract.cn: 想象即将响起的发令枪。

abstract.en: See a first page turning.
abstract.cn: 想象翻开的第 一页。

examples.en: The race will begin at noon.
examples.cn: 比赛将在中午开始。

examples.en: The course begins with the basics.
examples.cn: 这门课从基础开始。

examples.en: She began to laugh.
examples.cn: 她笑了起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 begin 想成起跑线前弯腰待发的那一刻。

root: 由古英语 be- 与 ginnan「开始」构成 beginnan「开始、着手」，经中古英语 biginne 演变为今天的 begin，核心义为「开始」。

sensesIntro.en: To start an action, and to start from a first point.
sensesIntro.cn: 既指开始一个动作，也指从某个起点开始。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a runner waiting at the starting line.
core.cn: 核心意象：起跑线前等待的运动员。

intro.en: Begin takes -ning and -ner endings and doubles the final n.
intro.cn: begin 加 -ning、-ner 时双写末尾的 n。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the word is Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，这个词来自古英语。
